difficulty.reason: Creating an application and setting up OAuth2 redirect URIs and scopes is straightforward, but verification processes and bot approval requirements depend on scale and intents.

timeEstimate.notes: Exact setup and approval durations are not formally published in Discord developer documentation.

requirements.text: Access to the Discord Developer Portal.

steps.title: Navigate to Developer Portal
steps.description: Log into the Discord Developer Portal and click 'New Application'.

steps.title: Configure OAuth2 Settings
steps.description: Go to the OAuth2 tab within your application settings to find your Client ID and Client Secret, and add redirect URIs.

blockers.problem: App verification required for bots in over 100 servers or requesting privileged intents.
blockers.solution: Submit the application for verification through the Discord Developer Portal providing required identity information and use case details.

agentCanDo: Interact with Discord APIs using valid user or bot tokens once authenticated.
Handle automated messaging and channel management based on granted scopes.
developerMustDo: Create the application in the Discord Developer Portal.
Configure OAuth2 client credentials and redirect URLs.
Handle app verification and submit necessary compliance details if scaling.

managedOption.managedSufficientWhen: Managed OAuth (such as Composio) is sufficient when you want to delegate authentication, token management, and integration handling without manually implementing the Discord OAuth2 authorization code exchange flow. This tool was built for a Composio assignment, and Composio sells managed OAuth.
managedOption.customRequiredWhen: Custom developer credentials are required when you need direct ownership of the Discord application, custom branding in the OAuth consent screen, or specific privileged bot intents managed entirely within your own organization's developer account.

claims.claim: Discord OAuth app registration workflow and permission configuration.

openQuestions: What is the exact average approval wait time for Discord app verification?
